label: Diagram 5.1
caption: Diagram 5.1
description: The drawing is a three‑dimensional perspective (axonometric) view of part of a building, showing the boundary between a garage and a dwellinghouse. A green‑shaded vertical wall together with an adjoining green floor slab forms the separation. Inside the green wall a dashed rectangle marks a door, indicated by a dashed leader line from the upper‑left text. The labels read, top left, "See paras 5.6 and 5.7"; "Fire doors between the garage and dwellinghouse to have a minimum fire resistance of E 30 S a and be fitted with a self‑closing device", pointing to that door; "The door opening threshold should be a minimum of 100mm above garage floor", pointing to the lower edge of the green wall; "or Floor to fall away from door to the outside", pointing to the floor slab, which carries the word "Fall" with an arrow sloping away from the door; and on the right, "Wall and any floor between the garage and dwellinghouse to have a minimum fire resistance of REI 30 from the garage side", pointing to the green wall. A green banner along the bottom reads "Diagram 5.1 Separation between garage and dwellinghouse".

notes: The description says the door is "indicated by a dashed leader line from the upper‑left text", but the leader line running from the "Fire doors…" text to the dashed door rectangle is solid; the only dashed lines in that area are the hidden edges of the 3‑D box outline.
